dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: The work is getting more and more complicated, so we'll need to take extra caution when handling affairs...

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Thanks for asking! To put it simply, I'm responsible for liaison work between the Communications Office's Hezhe Post and the Millelith, the teahouses, the Secure Transport Agency, and other organizations.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: If the leader of a group of guards for hire has guards waiting to be dispatched, I'll go get an order from Hezhe Post.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: If the teahouse sends someone here to confirm a tea delivery order on its behalf, I'll direct them to talk to the appropriate harbor staff to discuss the details.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: If a merchant wants make a large shipment to a foreign port and needs to have his goods inspected and registered first, I'll connect them to a specialist at Hezhe Post...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It sounds like you've got a lot to do...

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: It can't be helped. After all, Yilong Wharf is a busy port with people coming and going all the time. Without someone in charge of coordinating all this activity, everything becomes a big mess in a big hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Sometimes, I don't even have time to enjoy a nice pot of tea with Gaming when he comes back... He's also always busy as a bee, heh.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Good thing Gaming has made so many friends here, so he doesn't need the likes of me worrying about him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it then, bye.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: It was my pleasure. See you next time!
